FN-CBF9WQJ-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 327
Committee: County & Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Chris Elliott
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/22/2024
Senate Bill 327 as introduced could reduce potential state and local tax receipts, if areas added
by Capital Improvement Districts, pursuant to the provisions of this bill, would otherwise be
subject to taxation.
Page 1

FN-CBF9WQJ-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 327
Committee: County & Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Chris Elliott
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/29/2024
Senate Bill 327 as passed the Senate could reduce various potential state and local tax receipts
by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of any taxes otherwise collected related to
any property or projects added to a Capital Improvement District, pursuant to the provisions of
this bill.
